page.layout: One printed page. Running head with page number at top, then a centred division heading block (XLVII, title, subtitle), then one text column of running text. No marginal notes.

main_text.head: XLVII. LEGATI EPISTOLA AD ELECTOREM BRANDEBURGICUM.
main_text.p: Absoluta Legatione nostra tum apud Illustriss. Electorem Saxoniae, nonnullosque alios Principes, cum etiam apud Serenissimum Daniae Regem, decrevetam ulterius pergere & ad alios Augustanae Confessionis Principes iter arripere. Verum illatus Nuntius de mandato ad Illustrissimum Bavariae Ducem ad Imperatore misso, quo ut intercipiar & in custodiam conjiciar edicitur, à profectione suscipienda deterruit, donec Imperatoris voluntatem planius intelligam, cum enim Berlino Dresdam
main_text.notes: Heavy show-through and damage in the middle of the text block (lines beginning "Absoluta" to "Principes iter"): several words are smudged and uncertain, including "Saxoniae", "nonnullosque", "Daniae", "Augustanae" and "illatus". The heading's title line and the first line of the letter's opening are partly blotted. The line ending "Dres-" continues on the word "dam" printed at the right. Also a dark mark at the lower left, which is not printed text.
